scientific_integrity: Braunfeld's Fraïssé construction and the classical enumeration/asymptotics of ordered Bell numbers are treated as prior work. The contribution is restricted to the exact orbit identification, the repeated-coordinate Stirling transform, and the derived 1/sqrt(2) limiting injective fraction.
scientific_limitations: The originality assessment is literature-based and cannot exclude an unindexed equivalent calculation.
The asymptotic uses the classical ordered-Bell-number estimate rather than reproving it from singularity analysis.
The result is specific to Braunfeld's Example 2.7 and is not asserted for all homogeneous finite-dimensional permutation structures.
No independent audit has yet been performed.
title: Fubini-factorial orbit profile and a 1/sqrt(2) injectivity constant for Braunfeld's exceptional homogeneous permutation structure
